capabilities: Render interactive timelines from chronos code blocks in notes
Generate timelines from note text with AI providers
Edit timeline markdown with AI proposals
Generate combined timelines from all Chronos items in a folder
Show Bases views as timelines built from note properties
extras: AI features are off unless a provider is configured; Ollama and LM Studio need no API key. The README warns that the ORDERBY flag can make large timelines laggy. Note linking is labeled beta.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn dated note content into an interactive, inline timeline visualization.

relations.evidence: Powered by chronos-timeline-md, a markdown wrapper for vis-timeline.

requires.name: Cloud AI provider API key via Obsidian SecretStorage
Ollama or LM Studio for local AI models

summary: Markdown code-block plugin that renders interactive timelines in notes, with AI generation, folder-wide aggregation, and a Bases view.
